Write the person's corrections for the agent's next round

Source: R/ai_corrections.R
tfl_ai_corrections.Rd

Gathers what the person wants changed into one file, ai/corrections.md, which the agent works through in its next round (round 2 of its instructions, AGENTS.md): from the person's list of reports (tfl_ai_expected_write()) each report to add, drop or change and each note on what a report should show, and each question of ai/questions.md the person has answered (still open). One section an item – ## C<n>. add ..., ## Q<n> (answered). ... – with - Status: open, which the agent sets to done once it has done it.

Usage

tfl_ai_corrections(study_dir = ".")

Arguments

study_dir

The study folder.

Value

The sections written this time (their headings), invisibly; the file is ai/corrections.md.

Details

Each assumption of the AI the person answered wrong (tfl_ai_assumption_answers_write()) is a section too: one report's (## A12. assumption of T-14-1-1: <item>, with - Was: and - Correct:) or every report of its kind's (## K3. assumption of every report: <item>, with - Reports: too). An answer ok needs no section. An answer changed while its section is open changes its - Correct:; an answer removed (or no longer wrong) while its section is open sets it - Status: withdrawn. A question of ai/questions.md whose assumptions are all answered is answered first from them (unless the person has written its answer).

Written again (after more corrections), the sections there are kept as they are – their number, their status, what the agent wrote – and only new ones are added: the same correction is never written twice. The person then tells the agent "the answers and corrections are written".

See also

tfl_ai_outputs(), tfl_ai_questions()
